plugin.name: MatronReporter
plugin.author: Eric
plugin.purpose: Times Matron Dragon runs and reports rewards

trigger.match: You stumble forward and find yourself in a large, very angry dragon's lair!
^You manage to loot a .+ Trivia Point Token from the lair\.$
You manage to grab some loot before escaping the collapsing lair.

muclient.script:
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Colour tables matching SKDReport theme --------------------------------------------------------------------------- local MUSH_COLOR = { white = "white", cyan = "#00D7FF", yellow = "#875FFF", red = "#00FF87", } local AARD_COLOR = { white = "@W", cyan = "@x045", yellow = "@x099", red = "@x048", }
local function BuildLine(segments) local parts, plain, aard = {}, {}, {} for _, seg in ipairs(segments) do table.insert(parts, MUSH_COLOR[seg[1]] or seg[1]) table.insert(parts, "") table.insert(parts, seg[2]) table.insert(plain, seg[2]) table.insert(aard, (AARD_COLOR[seg[1]] or "@W") .. seg[2]) end return parts, table.concat(plain), table.concat(aard) .. "@w" end
local ANOTE_MAP = { ["@x045"] = "#00D7FF", ["@x099"] = "#875FFF", ["@x048"] = "#00FF87", ["@W"] = "white", ["@w"] = "silver", } local function ANote(msg) local args = {} local pos = 1 while pos <= #msg do local code, rest = msg:match("^(@[xX]%d%d%d)(.*)", pos) if not code then code, rest = msg:match("^(@[Ww])(.*)", pos) end if code then local col = ANOTE_MAP[code] or "white" local text = rest:match("^([^@]*)") or "" table.insert(args, col) ; table.insert(args, "") ; table.insert(args, text) pos = pos + #code + #text else local text = msg:match("^([^@]+)", pos) or msg:sub(pos, pos) table.insert(args, "white") ; table.insert(args, "") ; table.insert(args, text) pos = pos + #text end end if #args > 0 then ColourNote(unpack(args)) end end
local COL_HDR = "@x045" local COL_VAL = "@W" local COL_ACC = "@x045" local COL_TIME = "@x048" local COL_SEP = "@x099" local COL_GOOD = "@x048" local COL_LBL = "@W" local COL_ITEM = "@x099"
local SEP = COL_SEP .. string.rep("-", 60) .. "@w"
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Date / time helpers -- Matron is on a 23 hour lockout, so we also work out the next legal run. --------------------------------------------------------------------------- local COOLDOWN = 23 * 3600
local MONTH_NAMES = { "January", "February", "March", "April", "May", "June", "July", "August", "September", "October", "November", "December" }
-- Format an os.time() value as "August 21 2026 3:45pm" local function FmtStamp(ts) if not ts or ts == 0 then return "unknown" end local t = os.date("*t", ts) local h = t.hour % 12 if h == 0 then h = 12 end return string.format("%s %d %d %d:%02d%s", MONTH_NAMES[t.month], t.day, t.year, h, t.min, (t.hour < 12) and "am" or "pm") end
-- Format a duration in seconds as "8h 12m" / "45m" / "30s" local function FmtDur(secs) if not secs or secs < 0 then secs = 0 end local h = math.floor(secs / 3600) local m = math.floor((secs % 3600) / 60) if h > 0 then return string.format("%dh %02dm", h, m) end if m > 0 then return string.format("%dm", m) end return string.format("%ds", secs) end
-- "available now" or "August 22 2026 2:45pm (in 8h 12m)" local function NextRunLabel(ts) if not ts or ts == 0 then return "unknown" end local nextTs = ts + COOLDOWN local now = os.time() if now >= nextTs then return "available now" end return FmtStamp(nextTs) .. " (in " .. FmtDur(nextTs - now) .. ")" end
-- Tack [<label>: date] (and optionally [Next: ...]) onto a report line local function AppendStampSegs(segs, ts, label, withNext) if not ts or ts == 0 then return segs end segs[#segs+1] = {"white", " ["} segs[#segs+1] = {"yellow", label} segs[#segs+1] = {"white", ": "} segs[#segs+1] = {"red", FmtStamp(ts)} segs[#segs+1] = {"white", "]"} if withNext then segs[#segs+1] = {"white", " ["} segs[#segs+1] = {"yellow", "Next"} segs[#segs+1] = {"white", ": "} segs[#segs+1] = {"red", NextRunLabel(ts)} segs[#segs+1] = {"white", "]"} end return segs end
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Known reward types for per-run % tracking -- Each run record stores which of these appeared (0 or 1 per run) --------------------------------------------------------------------------- local REWARD_KEYS = { "TP Token", "Mirage of an Oasis", "Sunburst Shield", "Quest Points", "Training Sessions", "Gold", }
-- Outlier guard: after a death-and-resume, the timer restarts on re-entry and -- produces an unrealistically short run. Reject runs that fall outside a window -- around the current average so they don't skew the long-term stats. local OUTLIER_MIN_RUNS = 3 -- need this many recorded runs before judging local OUTLIER_UNDER = 60 -- reject if more than 1 min shorter than average local OUTLIER_OVER = 120 -- reject if more than 2 min longer than average
-- Plugin state local runActive = false local startTime = 0 local elapsed = 0 local finalizeGen = 0 local pendingGen = 0 local pendingLoots = {}
local CHAN_KEY = "matron_report_channel" local DATA_FILE = GetInfo(66) .. "matron_runs.txt" local CHAN_FILE = GetInfo(66) .. "matron_channel.txt" local DEFAULT_CHANNEL = "gt"
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Report channel persistence -- Plugin variables only reach disk when MUSHclient shuts down cleanly, so a -- crash (or a manual reinstall) used to silently drop the channel back to the -- default. Write it to our own file instead - that lands immediately. --------------------------------------------------------------------------- local function LoadChannel() local f = io.open(CHAN_FILE, "r") if f then local raw = f:read("*line") f:close() local chan = raw and raw:match("^%s*(%S+)%s*$") if chan then return chan end end -- fall back to the old plugin variable (pre-1.7), then the built-in default local v = GetVariable(CHAN_KEY) if v and v ~= "" then return v end return DEFAULT_CHANNEL end
local function SaveChannel(chan) SetVariable(CHAN_KEY, chan) local f = io.open(CHAN_FILE, "w") if not f then ColourNote("white", "", "[MatronReporter] ERROR: Could not write to " .. CHAN_FILE) return false end f:write(chan) f:close() return true end
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Persistence --------------------------------------------------------------------------- local function LoadRuns() local f = io.open(DATA_FILE, "r") if not f then return {} end local raw = f:read("*all") f:close() if not raw or raw == "" then return {} end local fn, err = loadstring("return " .. raw) if not fn then ColourNote("white", "", "[MatronReporter] LoadRuns parse error: " .. tostring(err)) return {} end local ok, t = pcall(fn) if not ok or type(t) ~= "table" then ColourNote("white", "", "[MatronReporter] LoadRuns exec error: " .. tostring(t)) return {} end return t end
local function SaveRuns(runs) local entries = {} for _, r in ipairs(runs) do local lparts = {} for _, loot in ipairs(r.loots) do lparts[#lparts+1] = string.format("%q", loot) end entries[#entries+1] = string.format("{secs=%d,ts=%d,loots={%s}}", r.secs, r.ts or 0, table.concat(lparts, ",")) end local f = io.open(DATA_FILE, "w") if not f then ColourNote("white", "", "[MatronReporter] ERROR: Could not write to " .. DATA_FILE) return end f:write("{" .. table.concat(entries, ",") .. "}") f:close() end
-- Timestamp of the most recent run that has one. Runs recorded before v1.5 -- have no timestamp, so walk backwards until we find a real one. local function LastRunTS() local runs = LoadRuns() for i = #runs, 1, -1 do if runs[i].ts and runs[i].ts > 0 then return runs[i].ts end end return nil end
-- Normalize a raw loot string to one of the REWARD_KEYS categories local function NormalizeReward(loot) if loot == "TP Token" then return "TP Token" end if loot == "Mirage of an Oasis" then return "Mirage of an Oasis" end if loot == "Sunburst Shield" then return "Sunburst Shield" end if loot:match("Quest Points$") then return "Quest Points" end if loot:match("Training Sessions$") then return "Training Sessions" end if loot:match("[Gg]old$") then return "Gold" end return loot -- unknown item, keep as-is end
-- Derive stats: per-run presence counts for each reward type local function CalcTotals(runs) local totalSecs = 0 -- presence[key] = number of runs where this reward appeared at least once local presence = {} for _, key in ipairs(REWARD_KEYS) do presence[key] = 0 end
for _, r in ipairs(runs) do totalSecs = totalSecs + r.secs local seen = {} for _, loot in ipairs(r.loots) do local key = NormalizeReward(loot) if not seen[key] then seen[key] = true presence[key] = (presence[key] or 0) + 1 end end end return { runs=#runs, totalSecs=totalSecs, presence=presence } end
local function GetChannel() return LoadChannel() end
local function FmtTime(secs) local m = math.floor(secs / 60) local s = secs % 60 if m > 0 then return string.format("%dm %02ds", m, s) else return string.format("%ds", s) end end
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Finalize --------------------------------------------------------------------------- function MatronFinalizeCallback() if runActive and finalizeGen == pendingGen then FinalizeRun() end end
local function ArmFinalize() pendingGen = finalizeGen DoAfterSpecial(1.5, "MatronFinalizeCallback()", 12) end
function FinalizeRun() runActive = false
local runs = LoadRuns()
-- Outlier check against the average of previously recorded runs. -- A death-and-resume restarts the timer and yields an unrealistic time. Rather -- than drop the run (which would skew loot % and the run count), we keep the run -- but substitute the average time so it counts as a run without moving the avg. if #runs >= OUTLIER_MIN_RUNS then local sum = 0 for _, r in ipairs(runs) do sum = sum + r.secs end local avg = math.floor(sum / #runs) if elapsed < avg - OUTLIER_UNDER or elapsed > avg + OUTLIER_OVER then ANote(COL_HDR .. "[Matron] " .. COL_LBL .. "Run of " .. COL_TIME .. FmtTime(elapsed) .. COL_LBL .. " outside " .. FmtTime(avg - OUTLIER_UNDER) .. "-" .. FmtTime(avg + OUTLIER_OVER) .. " window (likely a death/resume); counting it at the average " .. COL_TIME .. FmtTime(avg) .. COL_LBL .. " instead.") elapsed = avg end end
local finishedAt = os.time() runs[#runs+1] = { secs=elapsed, ts=finishedAt, loots=pendingLoots } SaveRuns(runs) local stats = CalcTotals(runs) local runNum = #runs
_G._matron_last = { elapsed=elapsed, loots=pendingLoots, runNum=runNum, ts=finishedAt }
local segs = { {"cyan", "Matron"}, {"white", " #"}, {"red", tostring(runNum)}, {"white", " ["}, {"yellow", "Time"}, {"white", ": "}, {"red", FmtTime(elapsed)}, {"white", "] ["}, {"yellow", "Loot"}, {"white", ": "}, } for i, r in ipairs(pendingLoots) do if i > 1 then segs[#segs+1] = {"white", ", "} end segs[#segs+1] = {"red", r} end segs[#segs+1] = {"white", "]"} AppendStampSegs(segs, finishedAt, "Ran", true) local _, _, aard = BuildLine(segs) Send(GetChannel() .. " " .. aard) end
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Trigger callbacks --------------------------------------------------------------------------- function RunStart() runActive = true startTime = os.time() pendingLoots = {} finalizeGen = finalizeGen + 1 elapsed = 0 ANote(COL_HDR .. "[Matron] " .. COL_LBL .. "Run timer started.") end
function RunSnapshot() if not runActive then return end elapsed = os.time() - startTime end
function LootGlassToken() if not runActive then return end pendingLoots[#pendingLoots+1] = "TP Token" ArmFinalize() end
function LootNamedItem(name, line, wildcards) if not runActive then return end local item = wildcards[1] if item and item ~= "" then pendingLoots[#pendingLoots+1] = item ArmFinalize() end end
function LootQuestPoints(name, line, wildcards) if not runActive then return end if wildcards[1] then pendingLoots[#pendingLoots+1] = wildcards[1] .. " Quest Points" ArmFinalize() end end
function LootTrainingSessions(name, line, wildcards) if not runActive then return end if wildcards[1] then pendingLoots[#pendingLoots+1] = wildcards[1] .. " Training Sessions" ArmFinalize() end end
function LootGold(name, line, wildcards) if not runActive then return end if wildcards[1] then pendingLoots[#pendingLoots+1] = wildcards[1] .. " Gold" ArmFinalize() end end
--------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Alias callbacks --------------------------------------------------------------------------- function DumpRuns() ColourNote("#00D7FF", "", "[MatronReporter] Data file: " .. DATA_FILE) local runs = LoadRuns() ColourNote("#00D7FF", "", "[MatronReporter] Loaded " .. #runs .. " runs.") for i, r in ipairs(runs) do ColourNote("#00FF87", "", " Run " .. i .. ": secs=" .. tostring(r.secs) .. " loots=" .. table.concat(r.loots or {}, ", ")) end end
-- Manually inject a run: matronreportinject <secs> <loot1>|<loot2>|... -- Example: matronreportinject 130 26 Quest Points|Mirage of an Oasis function InjectRun(name, line, wildcards) local secs = tonumber(wildcards[1]) local lootstr = wildcards[2] if not secs or not lootstr then ColourNote("white", "", "[MatronReporter] Usage: matronreportinject <secs> <loot1>|<loot2>|...") return end local loots = {} for item in lootstr:gmatch("([^|]+)") do loots[#loots+1] = item:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") -- trim whitespace end local runs = LoadRuns() runs[#runs+1] = { secs=secs, ts=os.time(), loots=loots } SaveRuns(runs) ColourNote("#00FF87", "", "[MatronReporter] Injected run #" .. #runs .. ": " .. secs .. "s | " .. table.concat(loots, ", ")) end
function SetReportChannel(name, line, wildcards) local chan = wildcards[1]:lower() if SaveChannel(chan) then ANote(COL_HDR .. "[Matron] " .. COL_LBL .. "Report channel set to: " .. COL_VAL .. chan .. COL_LBL .. " - saved, this survives restarts now.") end end
function ShowChannel() ANote(COL_HDR .. "[Matron] " .. COL_LBL .. "Reports currently go to: " .. COL_VAL .. GetChannel()) ANote(COL_LBL .. " Change it with " .. COL_ACC .. "matronreportchan <channel>") end
function SendReport(name, line, wildcards) local chan = (wildcards[1] and wildcards[1] ~= "") and wildcards[1]:lower() or GetChannel() local last = _G._matron_last if not last then ANote(COL_HDR .. "[Matron] " .. COL_LBL .. "No completed run to report yet.") return end
local segs = { {"cyan", "Matron"}, {"white", " #"}, {"red", tostring(last.runNum)}, {"white", " ["}, {"yellow", "Time"}, {"white", ": "}, {"red", FmtTime(last.elapsed)}, {"white", "] ["}, {"yellow", "Loot"}, {"white", ": "}, } for i, r in ipairs(last.loots) do if i > 1 then segs[#segs+1] = {"white", ", "} end segs[#segs+1] = {"red", r} end segs[#segs+1] = {"white", "]"} AppendStampSegs(segs, last.ts or LastRunTS(), "Ran", true) local _, _, aard = BuildLine(segs) Send(chan .. " " .. aard) end
function ShowLifetimeStats(name, line, wildcards) local runs = LoadRuns() local stats = CalcTotals(runs) if stats.runs == 0 then ANote(COL_HDR .. "[Matron] " .. COL_LBL .. "No runs recorded yet.") return end
local chan = (wildcards and wildcards[1] and wildcards[1] ~= "") and wildcards[1]:lower() or GetChannel() local avgSecs = math.floor(stats.totalSecs / stats.runs)
local segs = { {"cyan", "Matron Life"}, {"white", " ["}, {"yellow", "Runs"}, {"white", ": "}, {"red", tostring(stats.runs)}, {"white", "] ["}, {"yellow", "Avg"}, {"white", ": "}, {"red", FmtTime(avgSecs)}, {"white", "]"}, } for _, key in ipairs(REWARD_KEYS) do local cnt = stats.presence[key] or 0 local pct = string.format("%.0f", cnt / stats.runs * 100) segs[#segs+1] = {"white", " ["} segs[#segs+1] = {"yellow", key} segs[#segs+1] = {"white", ": "} segs[#segs+1] = {"red", pct .. "%"} segs[#segs+1] = {"white", "]"} end AppendStampSegs(segs, LastRunTS(), "Last", true)
local _, _, aard = BuildLine(segs) Send(chan .. " " .. aard) end
-- One-line status sent to the report channel, same as the other reports. function ShowStatus(name, line, wildcards) local ts = LastRunTS() if not ts then ANote(COL_HDR .. "[Matron] " .. COL_LBL .. "No timestamped run recorded yet - finish one run and this starts tracking.") return end local chan = (wildcards and wildcards[1] and wildcards[1] ~= "") and wildcards[1]:lower() or GetChannel() local segs = { {"cyan", "Matron Status"} } AppendStampSegs(segs, ts, "Last", true) local _, _, aard = BuildLine(segs) Send(chan .. " " .. aard) end
function ShowHelp() ANote(SEP) ANote(COL_HDR .. " -=- MATRON REPORTER HELP -=-") ANote(SEP) ANote(COL_LBL .. " " .. COL_ACC .. "matronreportchan <channel>" .. COL_LBL .. " - Set default report channel (e.g. gt, clan, spo)") ANote(COL_LBL .. " " .. COL_ACC .. "matronreportchan" .. COL_LBL .. " - Show which channel reports go to") ANote(COL_LBL .. " " .. COL_ACC .. "matronreport <channel>" .. COL_LBL .. " - Resend last run report to <channel>") ANote(COL_LBL .. " " .. COL_ACC .. "matronreportlife <channel>" .. COL_LBL .. " - Send lifetime stats to <channel>") ANote(COL_LBL .. " " .. COL_ACC .. "matronstatus <channel>" .. COL_LBL .. " - Last run + when the 23h lockout is up") ANote(COL_LBL .. " " .. COL_ACC .. "matronreporthelp" .. COL_LBL .. " - Show this help") ANote(SEP) ANote(COL_LBL .. " Timer starts on entering the lair, snaps on escape line.") ANote(COL_LBL .. " Report auto-sends to channel on run complete.") ANote(SEP) end
function OnPluginInstall() ANote(COL_HDR .. "[MatronReporter] " .. COL_LBL .. "Loaded. Reporting to " .. COL_VAL .. GetChannel() .. COL_LBL .. ". Type " .. COL_ACC .. "matronreporthelp" .. COL_LBL .. " for commands.") end
function OnPluginEnable() OnPluginInstall() end
